title: Fluent
subtitle: 本課限定語境：fluent = able to speak, write, or communicate smoothly, easily, and with good contr
description: 本課限定語境：fluent = able to speak, write, or communicate smoothly, easily, and with good control · 「流利的；表達順暢的」

words.note: 表示在某種語言、技能或工作上具有較高水平。
words.example: She is proficient in French and German.

exercises.original: She is fluent in French and can use it confidently at work.
exercises.zh: 她法語熟練，能在工作中自信使用。
exercises.upgrade: She is proficient in French.

options.explanation: proficient in French 是標準搭配，表示較高語言能力。
通常只表示可應付日常對話，程度可能低於 fluent。
表示表達清楚，不等於語言整體熟練。
太廣，一般不說 skilled in French 來描述語言程度。
表示使用兩種語言，不直接說明這一語言的流利程度。

exercises.original: Applicants must be fluent in spreadsheet software and data analysis tools.
exercises.zh: 申請人必須熟練使用試算表軟件和數據分析工具。
exercises.upgrade: Applicants must be proficient in spreadsheet software and data analysis tools.

options.explanation: 非語言技能最自然用 proficient。
比喻可用，但在軟件技能語境不如 proficient 標準。
也接近，但常說 skilled at/in using...，句法不同。
表示足夠勝任，強度可能較低。

exercises.original: He became fluent in using the new software after several months of training.
exercises.zh: 經過數月訓練，他熟練掌握了新軟件。
exercises.upgrade: He became proficient in using the new software.

options.explanation: 軟件操作能力高，最自然。
也可，但表示足以勝任，通常稍弱。
可用，但通常改成 skilled at using...。

words.note: 是對 fluent 很直接的描述性改寫。
words.example: He is able to speak smoothly without long pauses.
words.exampleZh: 他能流暢說話，不會經常長時間停頓。

exercises.original: After two years abroad, she could speak English fluently without long pauses.
exercises.zh: 在海外兩年後，她能流暢地說英語，不會長時間停頓。
exercises.upgrade: She was able to speak smoothly without long pauses.

options.explanation: 直接拆解 fluent 的核心：說話自然、停頓少。
強調表達清楚，不一定代表語言整體流利。
也很接近，但更廣泛指整體能力。

exercises.original: He is fluent enough to answer questions naturally in meetings.
exercises.zh: 他流利到能在會議中自然回答問題。
exercises.upgrade: He is able to speak smoothly enough to answer questions naturally in meetings.

options.explanation: 自然、連貫回答問題正是流利口語的核心。
表示表達優美、有說服力，強度更高。
可能只是日常對話能力。

exercises.original: The student is becoming fluent and no longer stops after every few words.
exercises.zh: 學生愈來愈流利，不再每幾個字便停下來。
exercises.upgrade: The student is becoming able to speak smoothly without frequent pauses.

options.explanation: 可以很準確但仍說得很慢。
清楚表達不必然代表少停頓。
比 fluent 更高、更接近母語者，不應隨便推斷。

words.note: 表示某人在某項活動中有良好技巧。
words.exampleZh: 她是一位表達技巧熟練的人。

exercises.original: She is a fluent communicator who handles difficult conversations well.
exercises.zh: 她是一位技巧熟練的溝通者，能妥善處理困難對話。
exercises.upgrade: She is a skilled communicator.

options.explanation: 重點是溝通技巧和實際處理能力。
也可表示熟練，但 skilled communicator 更自然。

exercises.original: He is fluent at explaining technical ideas to non-specialists.
exercises.zh: 他很擅長向非專業人士解釋技術概念。
exercises.upgrade: He is skilled at explaining technical ideas to non-specialists.

options.explanation: skilled at doing something 是自然技能結構。
也接近，但更偏清楚表達，而非整體技巧。
通常說 proficient in...，句法不同。
強度較高，也偏演說／文筆。

exercises.original: The interpreter is fluent and highly capable in difficult negotiations.
exercises.zh: 這位傳譯員技巧熟練，能處理困難談判。
exercises.upgrade: The interpreter is skilled and highly capable in difficult negotiations.

options.explanation: 談判處理能力需要專業技巧，最合適。
程度太低，也只說日常對話。
母語身份不代表傳譯技能。

words.meaning: 表達清楚的；善於表達的
words.note: 表示能清楚、有條理地表達思想。
words.example: He is articulate and explains complex ideas clearly.
words.exampleZh: 他很善於表達，能清楚解釋複雜概念。

exercises.original: She is fluent and can explain complicated ideas clearly.
exercises.zh: 她善於表達，能清楚解釋複雜概念。
exercises.upgrade: She is articulate and can explain complicated ideas clearly.

options.explanation: 也可，但更強調優美、有說服力。
較廣，不一定突出表達清晰。
也可，但不如 articulate 直接。

exercises.original: The candidate was fluent when discussing her ideas in the interview.
exercises.zh: 候選人在面試中表達想法非常清楚。
exercises.upgrade: The candidate was articulate when discussing her ideas.

options.explanation: 面試中清楚、有條理表達想法最自然。
若表達特別優美、有感染力才更合適。
可能自信但表達不一定清楚。
需要指出在哪個技能 proficient。
可說 smooth delivery，但不直接等同 articulate。

exercises.original: He is a fluent speaker who chooses words carefully and expresses himself clearly.
exercises.zh: 他是一位善於表達的講者，用詞謹慎、表達清晰。
exercises.upgrade: He is an articulate speaker.

options.explanation: 用詞清楚、有條理是核心。
說話快不等於表達清楚。

words.meaning: 雄辯的；表達優美有說服力的
words.note: 表示說話或寫作不只流利，而且優美、有感染力。
words.example: She gave an eloquent speech about education.
words.exampleZh: 她就教育議題發表了一篇優美而有說服力的演說。

exercises.original: She gave a fluent and beautifully expressed speech about education.
exercises.zh: 她發表了一篇表達優美、很有說服力的教育演說。
exercises.upgrade: She gave an eloquent speech about education.

options.explanation: beautifully expressed 直接支持 eloquent。
表示清楚，但未必優美、有感染力。
不自然形容 speech 本身。
可以流暢，但不表示有說服力。

exercises.original: His fluent explanation persuaded even skeptical listeners.
exercises.zh: 他雄辯流暢的解釋連持懷疑態度的聽眾也說服了。
exercises.upgrade: His eloquent explanation persuaded even skeptical listeners.

options.explanation: 有說服力＋表達優美，最合適。
清楚但不一定有說服力。

exercises.original: The writer's fluent prose made a powerful emotional impression.
exercises.zh: 作家的文筆優美流暢，帶來強烈情感感染力。
exercises.upgrade: The writer's eloquent prose made a powerful emotional impression.

options.explanation: 文筆不只流暢，還有強烈感染力。
也很自然，但只強調文句連貫流暢。

words.note: 當 fluent 描述說話、表達或表現沒有明顯停頓和阻礙時可接近。
words.example: His delivery was smooth and confident.

exercises.original: His speech was fluent, with almost no hesitation.
exercises.zh: 他的演說很流暢，幾乎沒有停頓。
exercises.upgrade: His delivery was smooth, with almost no hesitation.

options.explanation: almost no hesitation 直接表示表達順暢。
通常形容人或能力，不形容 delivery。
速度快不等於沒有生硬停頓。

exercises.original: The conversation was fluent and natural from the beginning.
exercises.zh: 對話從一開始便流暢自然。
exercises.upgrade: The conversation was smooth and natural from the beginning.

options.explanation: 對話沒有障礙、停頓少，最自然。
也很接近，尤其強調自然連續。
表示風格像對話，不等於流暢。

exercises.original: Her fluent delivery made the presentation easy to follow.
exercises.zh: 她流暢的表達令簡報很容易跟上。
exercises.upgrade: Her smooth delivery made the presentation easy to follow.

options.explanation: 若內容特別優美有說服力才更合適。

words.note: 表示語言、寫作或表達自然連續、不生硬。
words.example: Her writing is clear and flowing.

exercises.original: Her writing is fluent and easy to read.
exercises.zh: 她的文筆流暢，容易閱讀。
exercises.upgrade: Her writing is flowing and easy to read.

options.explanation: writing/prose 自然連貫是典型用法。
也很自然，但 flowing 更常描述文字節奏和連續性。
比題句更強，含優美、有感染力。
形容作者技能，不形容 writing 本身。

exercises.original: The essay has a fluent style with clear transitions between paragraphs.
exercises.zh: 文章文風流暢，段落之間過渡清晰。
exercises.upgrade: The essay has a flowing style.

options.explanation: clear transitions 直接支持自然連貫的文風。
需要更強的修辭和感染力。
名詞／動詞，不能直接修飾 style。

exercises.original: His fluent prose made the complex topic surprisingly easy to follow.
exercises.zh: 他的文筆流暢，令複雜主題意外地容易理解。
exercises.upgrade: His flowing prose made the topic easy to follow.

options.explanation: prose 的自然連續和閱讀流暢是核心。
若文字有特別優美說服力也可。
也自然，但 flowing 更文體化。

words.note: 表示能力足以良好完成某項任務。
words.example: He is a competent speaker of Spanish.
words.exampleZh: 他的西班牙語能力足以應付良好溝通。

exercises.original: He is fluent enough in Spanish to handle ordinary workplace conversations.
exercises.zh: 他的西班牙語能力足以應付一般職場對話。
exercises.upgrade: He is a competent speaker of Spanish.

options.explanation: 足以良好應付工作，但沒有證據顯示高度流利。
也很接近，但更限定日常會話。
原詞強度可能高於句子實際描述。

exercises.original: She is fluent at the basic tasks required for the role.
exercises.zh: 她能勝任職位要求的基本工作。
exercises.upgrade: She is competent at the basic tasks required for the role.

options.explanation: basic tasks required 表示足以勝任。
明顯過強，通常代表高水平。

exercises.original: The new employee is fluent enough to work independently after training.
exercises.zh: 新員工接受訓練後已有足夠能力獨立工作。
exercises.upgrade: The new employee is competent enough to work independently.

options.explanation: 能獨立完成工作，正是「勝任」層級。
也可能，但通常暗示較高熟練度。

words.note: 表示在某項技能上有很高水平。
words.example: She is an accomplished public speaker.
words.exampleZh: 她是一位非常純熟的公開演說者。

exercises.original: She is a highly fluent public speaker with years of experience.
exercises.zh: 她是一位技巧純熟、經驗豐富的公開演說者。
exercises.upgrade: She is an accomplished public speaker.

options.explanation: years of experience + 高水平表現，最符合。
強調語言優美、有說服力。
可以，但不如 accomplished 帶高造詣感。

exercises.original: He is a fluent pianist who performs professionally.
exercises.zh: 他是一位技藝純熟、以專業身分演出的鋼琴家。
exercises.upgrade: He is an accomplished pianist.

options.explanation: professional performance 暗示高水平造詣。
可以比喻演奏流暢，但不是最標準人物能力形容詞。

exercises.original: The translator is fluent and highly experienced in literary translation.
exercises.zh: 這位翻譯在文學翻譯方面造詣很高。
exercises.upgrade: The translator is accomplished in literary translation.

options.explanation: 高度經驗＋高水平專業成果，最適合。
也接近，但少了高造詣感。
講表達清楚，不是翻譯造詣。

words.meaning: 能進行日常對話的；具會話能力的
words.note: 表示能以某語言進行一般對話。
words.exampleZh: 他的日語能應付一般對話。

exercises.original: He is not fully fluent in Japanese, but he can manage everyday conversations.
exercises.zh: 他的日語未達完全流利，但能應付日常對話。
exercises.upgrade: He is conversational in Japanese.

options.explanation: not fully fluent + everyday conversations 直接界定此程度。

exercises.original: After six months of study, she was fluent enough to order food and chat with local people.
exercises.zh: 學習六個月後，她已能用該語言作一般日常對話。
exercises.upgrade: After six months of study, she was conversational.

options.explanation: order food + chat with locals 是日常會話層級。
通常需要更廣、更高水平。
可以清楚表達，但不直接是語言程度。

exercises.original: His French is fluent enough for travel, but not for complex professional discussions.
exercises.zh: 他的法語足以旅行時對話，但不足以應付複雜專業討論。
exercises.upgrade: His French is conversational, but not sufficient for complex professional discussions.

options.explanation: 能旅行交流但不能處理專業複雜議題，是典型 conversational level。
題句已明確說未達複雜專業討論能力，不宜過度標成 fluent。

falseSynonyms.zh: 母語的 ≠ 流利的 native speaker 是從小自然習得該語言的人； fluent speaker 可以是第二語言使用者。
雙語者 ≠ 必然兩種語言都完全流利 bilingual 表示使用兩種語言，但實際熟練程度可以不同。
能會話 ≠ 必然流利 conversational 通常表示能應付日常對話，程度往往低於 fluent。
準確 ≠ 流利 一個人可以說得很慢但很準確； 也可以說得流利但偶爾有文法錯誤。
說得快 ≠ 流利 fluency 包括自然、連貫和控制力，不只是速度。
自信 ≠ 流利 confidence 是心理狀態，不代表語言能力一定高。
詞性陷阱 - fluent = 形容詞 - fluency = 名詞 - fluently = 副詞
詞形不同 - proficient = 熟練的 - proficiency = 熟練程度
